focus: Students need to take at least 15 credit hours of focus area courses; at least 6 credit hours need to be from a single focus area; the rest from any course in focus areas 1-5. One must be a capstone (BEE 4530 or BEE 4590).
Up to 4 credits of research, project team, teaching or independent study taken in an engineering department may replace 1 focus area course.
The focus area lists are not carved in stone: courses can be added by petition (BEE department / CAP committee).
rules.thermodynamics: Thermodynamics BEE 2220, ENGRD 2210, Engineering Distribution CHEME 3130 or MSE 3030
upperBio: Any biological sciences course at the 2000-level or above which has a biology prerequisite and is taken for a letter grade.
One credit seminars may not be used to meet this requirement.
CEE 4510, wastewater microbiology, counts as an upper level bio course even though it is offered in an engineering department.
BIOG 4990 (undergraduate research in biology) and BIOG 4980 (undergraduate teaching in biology) may not be used for upper level bio.
